summary: Fetch the domains of a DNS credential from its provider

parameters.name: credentialID
parameters.description: ID of the DNS credential, as the list shows it

200.description: The zones of the provider, marked against the stored domains

400.description: The provider refused the credential (`error.dns-zones-forbidden`), the address is blocked (`error.dns-zones-blocked`) or the request failed (`error.dns-zones-failed`)

description:
Asks the provider's API for the zones the credential can read, with the saved secret opened for this one call. Nothing is stored: add the chosen names with `POST /nginx/dns-domains`. For a provider without a zone list (`lists_domains` false in the providers list) the answer is `supported: false` and no outside request is made. At most 1000 zones are listed (`truncated`). Each zone is marked `here` (already on this credential), `other` (on another credential of the same owner) or `new`.

Needs: Certificates manage
